notes.title: Untitled Goose Game is out! With two geese!
notes.content:
Oh, hello! Untitled Goose Game is now available! Here are a few little goodies for you to get excited about.

[h2]The game is 25% off![/h2]
As a launch treat, the game will be available at 25% off for the next two weeks.

[h2]Two horrible geese![/h2]
Starting today, you can play through the whole game with a friend, in our brand new two-player mode. Your saved progress can be played with either one or two geese, so if you start a game in single player, you can get a friend to join in and help you out (and vice versa, if you and your friend do such a bad job cooperating that you have a falling out and you need to go back to single player).

[previewyoutube=YRcGyzhT24g;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Remote Play Together is supported![/h2]
While two-player mode is local-multiplayer only, we’ve had a good time playing with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Remote Play Together[/url], which lets you play local-multiplayer games over the internet. Why not give it a try?

[h2]Some delightful little stickers are here![/h2]
We’ve teamed up with [url=https://twitter.com/elloradatura]Gabrielle Genevieve[/url] (one of the creators of the upcoming [url=https://paleroom.itch.io/small-talk]Small Talk[/url]) to make some little stickers that you can get from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/837470]Steam Points Shop[/url]. Express yourself using a beautiful little animation of a goose ringing a bell! Or peeking out of a box! Or lovely Jeremy Fish!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33508932/1947a56ea68ea25483a7699d8e4b8b8c9cc01b82.gif[/img]

That’s all for now! Please enjoy our Untitled Goose Game.
